cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised for missing my concert. Now tell me what you think it cost me to keep looking at your empty seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the cause of your absence. I'm asking about its effect on me. Keep those separate, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down. I watched the recording this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then look at the moment before the encore, when I turn toward the door. Start there. I was still expecting you; tell me you understand that part.
